items.text: CareBridge reads a photo of your medical document and explains it in simple words.
The photo is read on this computer by a local model. Nothing is sent to any outside service.
We keep the results, not the photo, unless you choose to keep the photo. Everything we keep is encrypted.
Saved results are kept until you delete them or 24 hours pass, whichever comes first.
You can delete everything now with one button. This also withdraws your consent.
We do not sell or share your data.
This is a class project prototype. It is not medical advice. Always confirm with your doctor or pharmacist.
The Tamil and Hindi texts are machine-drafted and have not been reviewed by native speakers.
The interaction information is limited. It was drafted from official drug labels by the project author and has not been reviewed by a pharmacist.

purposes.label: Read the photo of my document (required)
Save the results for this session (required)
Also keep the photo for this session (optional)
